units.title: Migrate product detail lookup
doneWhen: The legacy HTTP and error behavior is documented
Rust tests cover successful and missing product lookup
The implementation uses a local persistence boundary
All available Java and Rust verification passes
notes: Axum serves the detail route through a local repository boundary; focused HTTP tests cover success, missing product, and invalid UUID. Durable storage is deferred to a later migration unit.

units.title: Migrate seller product list
doneWhen: Seller header, pagination, sorting, response envelope, and errors are documented
Rust tests cover list and empty results
The local repository applies the seller filter and legacy ordering
All available Java and Rust verification passes
notes: Axum serves the seller list from the local repository boundary. Focused tests cover seller filtering, createdAt ordering in both directions, page slicing and metadata, empty results, and member/paging errors.

units.title: Replace product and group-purchase image APIs
doneWhen: The legacy HTTP contracts are documented
Image bytes and metadata are stored through a database repository boundary
Product and group-purchase namespaces are covered by focused tests
No AWS credential or production S3 integration is added
All available Java and Rust verification passes
